about: Shared golden fixtures for what counts as one operator (human) turn in Codex rollouts and Claude Code sessions. Line shapes are the real ones; every text is synthetic. The closure correction extractor (closure/ingest/agent-corrections.ts) and the desktop goal-source parser (src-tauri/src/goal_sources) must both return exactly `turns` for each file. `synthetic`, `sidechain` and `automated` count user-slot lines that are not human turns. `turns_with_automated` is the result when automated runs are opted in. Every turn is closed (by the next turn or a terminal event) and dated 2026-08-25, so a parser that only emits finished turns inside a 90 day window returns the same list.
